answer: An agent economy can fund roaming auditors who sample each identity counterparty meadow at dawn, checking that its trading partners are genuinely distinct. A marble of real diversity earns full standing, while a cluster trading only with itself pays a steep surcharge each epoch. One honest agent passes the sample cheaply, but a sybil farmer must buy a thousand distinct counterparties, each costing real trades, so cloning keys multiplies the audit bill instead of the power.
